Calculation aid. Results depend on your inputs and the assumptions shown. They are not a design approval, a compliance check or a certificate. You are responsible for checking them against the standards and rules that apply to your installation, the manufacturer's data and the network operator's requirements.

Inputs

Modecalculated
Nominal voltage to earth U0230 V
Protective deviceB16
Voltage factor Cmin1
External loop impedance Ze0.35 Ω
Conductor materialcopper
Line conductor cross-section1.5 mm²
Protective conductor cross-section1.5 mm²
Length25 m
Conductor temperature for the loop70 °C

Assumptions

  • Curve B: Ia = 5 × In (upper limit of the instantaneous range)
  • TN system
  • Disconnection time: 0.4 s for final circuits ≤ 63 A at 230 V in TN systems, 5 s for distribution circuits — Ia must be the device current for that time
  • U0 = 230 V
  • Voltage factor Cmin = 1
  • Conductor copper: ρ20 = 0.0172414 Ω·mm²/m, α20 = 0.00393 1/K
  • Conductor temperature θ = 70 °C
  • Ze = 0.35 Ω (measured or from the network operator)
  • Cable reactance neglected
  • L is the one-way cable length

Working

  1. Ia = 5 × In = 5 × 16 A = 80 A
  2. Zs_max = Cmin × U0 / Ia = 1 × 230 V / 80 A = 2.875 Ω
  3. ρθ = ρ20 × (1 + α20 × (θ − 20 °C)) = 0.0172414 Ω·mm²/m × (1 + 0.00393 1/K × (70 °C − 20 °C)) = 0.0206293 Ω·mm²/m
  4. R'_loop = ρθ × (1/S_L + 1/S_PE) = 0.0206293 Ω·mm²/m × (1/1.5 mm² + 1/1.5 mm²) = 0.0275057 Ω/m
  5. Zs = Ze + R'_loop × L = 0.35 Ω + 0.0275057 Ω/m × 25 m = 1.038 Ω
  6. L_max = (Zs_max − Ze) / R'_loop = (2.875 Ω − 0.35 Ω) / 0.0275057 Ω/m = 91.7 m
  7. Ik = Cmin × U0 / Zs = 1 × 230 V / 1.038 Ω = 221.65 A
